title: Healthy Home Workshop
venue: Larcom City Hall, City Council Chambers, 2nd Floor
description: Healthy homes start with knowing what to look for! Join the City of Ann Arbor for a FREE Healthy Homes Workshop. Learn how landlords and tenants can work together to keep homes safe and healthy. Local housing and safety professionals will cover common household hazards, property maintenance, indoor air quality and everyday safety tips. 301 E. Huron St. No registration is required. Helpful resources, contact information and light refreshments will be provided.

title: Ann Arbor Parks Plan Community Workshops
venue: Ann Arbor District Library - Downtown Branch
description:
You're invited to join two upcoming community workshops where you’ll learn about the many parts of the park system, from neighborhood parks and natural areas to trails, recreation programs and facilities, and how they all work together. Most importantly, we want your ideas. What do you love about Ann Arbor’s parks and open spaces? What’s missing, and what would you change? Your input will help guide decisions about the park system for years to come.


Pick a session below that fits your schedule and stop by any time. There will be activities for all ages and free food!


* Thursday, Nov. 12, 4-7 p.m. Ann Arbor Downtown Library, 343 S. 5th Ave.
* Saturday, Nov. 14, 11 a.m.-1 p.m., Veterans Memorial Ice Arena, 2150 Jackson Ave.


Ann Arbor Parks Plan: Share your feedback - complete a survey
In addition to these community workshops, you can provide opinions, feedback and contribute to a shared vision for the future of Ann Arbor parks by taking the community survey! Responses are due by Dec. 15. Click here to participate: www.surveymonkey.com…

title: Ann Arbor Sustainable Energy Utility Expanded Pilot Open House (income-eligible households)
venue: Ann Arbor District Library - Malletts Creek Branch
description:
The A2SEU is expanding service to income-eligible Ann Arbor households, citywide, including renters! Attend a drop-in session to learn what A2SEU solar and backup battery service could mean for you and your household. Please note, this pilot and open house are intended for residents who qualify for assistance program(s), such as Medicaid, the Michigan Energy Assistance Program (MEAP) or other. Stop by to ask questions and talk with an A2SEU staff member.


Three open houses - attend the one best for your schedule:
  • Sunday, Nov. 8, 10 a.m.–noon, Ann Arbor District Library, Downtown Branch, Whiffletree Room
  • Saturday, Nov. 14, 11 a.m.–1 p.m., Ann Arbor District Library, Malletts Creek Branch, Raingarden Room
  • Saturday, Nov. 21, 11 a.m.–1 p.m., Ann Arbor District Library, Traverwood Branch, Emerald Room
Additional ways to learn about the expanded pilot:

title: Monthly Clothing Swap
venue: Larcom City Hall, City Council Chambers, 2nd Floor
description:
​Join our monthly A²ZERO clothing swaps on the third Thursday of each month! Swaps are an opportunity to refresh your wardrobe, without buying new. Swaps are also a chance to gift your gently used clothes to members of your community, without contributing to the 92 million tons of textile waste generated globally each year. These are completely free events.  
​​​How it works: Each person can bring up to 10 items of clothing in good condition (no rips, holes, stains or unwashed items please!). Accessories such as bags, jewelry, and belts are also welcome. You can take clothing without bringing anything, or bring clothing without taking anything.  
​​​Skill Building Workshop: Stay tuned for more information!

title: Invasive Shrub Cutting at Bicentennial with OSI
description:
Show some love to Bicentennial Park! Join the City of Ann Arbor’s Office of Sustainability and Innovations and the Ann Arbor Parks Volunteer Program for a volunteer workday focused on removing invasive shrubs with handsaws and loppers.
Whether you’re a longtime volunteer or joining us for the first time, this is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors, connect with community members, and make a visible impact in a community park.
No prior experience is necessary—staff will provide all tools, supplies, training, and guidance throughout the event.
Come lend a hand, meet your community, and show your love for Ann Arbor Parks!
  •  Date: Friday, November 20, 2026
  •  Time: 3:00 – 5:00 p.m.
  •  Location: Bicentennial Park
    • Meeting location: Bicentennial Park parking lot
  •  Parking: There is a large parking lot located at the entrance.
What to expect:
  • Tasks include cutting back shrubs, trimming vines, and removing invasive vegetation
  • Work will be outdoors and there may be limited shade
  • All minors must be accompanied by a guardian
What to wear and bring:
  • Closed-toe shoes
  • Weather-appropriate clothes that can get dusty or dirty
  • Reusable water bottle
  • We’ll provide gloves, tools, and instruction

title: Park Workday
venue: Bicentennial Park, 2901 E Ellsworth Rd, Ann Arbor
description: Show some love to a city park! Join the City of Ann Arbor’s Office of Sustainability and Innovations and the Ann Arbor Parks Volunteer Program for a volunteer workday focused on caring for Ward Park’s playground area. To keep the play area safe, we’ll be spreading a fresh layer of play-safe woodchips under and around the equipment using wheelbarrows, pitchforks, and rakes. This task makes a big difference in safety and helps the playground look well cared for. No prior experience is necessary—staff will provide all tools, supplies, training, and guidance throughout the event.

title: A²ZERO TREEducation Series: Trees & Art
venue: Leslie Science & Nature Center, Energy House
description: Join OSI and the Leslie Science & Nature Center for our new A²ZERO TREEducation Series! This month, we will be focused on the intersection of trees and art - join us for a hands-on workshop where you'll learn about the influence of trees on art and have a chance to create your own tree-inspired art, followed by a (weather permitting) guided night hike in Leslie Park. Workshop begins at 6pm at the Leslie Science & Nature Center's Energy House.

title: Cinema & Sustainability Series: No Impact Man (with pre-screening Climate Cafe)
description:
In collaboration with Marquee Arts, OSI is sponsoring the return of the free Cinema & Sustainability film series, which explores sustainability, environmental stewardship, and the collective actions shaping a green future. The second film in the series, No Impact Man, will screen Thursday, December 3rd, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. at the Michigan Theater. Tickets can be reserved for free online at marquee-arts.org/cinema-and-sustainability. Please also consider joining us at 6pm before the screening to participate in a Climate Cafe discussion hosted by University of Michigan's Planet Blue.

The Cinema & Sustainability series will run through March, 2027.

title: Free Family Trivia Night
description:
Looking for a fun night of friendly competition? Gather your family and join us for Free Family Trivia at the Ann Arbor Senior Center. Questions range in difficulty for kids, teens, and adults, so everyone can participate. Teams may have up to eight people, and each participant must register in advance. Dec. 4 from 5–6:30 p.m. at the Ann Arbor Senior Center, 1320 Baldwin Ave. Participation is free, but preregistration is required. Space is limited.

Register here: https://secure.rec1.com/MI/city-of-ann-arbor/catalog?filter=c2VhcmNoPTQ0NDk0ODU=


Questions? Contact a2parksEvents@a2gov.org.
